title: Ilizwi Elichasene Nezisindo Zobuxoki
intro: Umphefumlo othembekileyo wakhuliswa phakathi kwabarhwebi nabarhwebi kwilizwe apho izikali zazityekile kwaye imilinganiselo yayifinyezwa. Lo mntu wema yedwa nxamnye nokungathembeki kwesizwe siphela, esibizela ekubeni silunge kwaye sinqule uThixo oNye oNyanisekileyo. Nangona umyalezo wawucacile kwaye ubizo lwalulungile, abantu bala ukumamela baza bajongana nesiphelo esibi. Ungamchaza lo mthunywa uhloniphekileyo kwiQuran?
clues: Ndathunywa njengomthunywa kubantu abaphila ubomi obujikeleze urhwebo norhwebo.
Abantu bakowethu babesaziwa kulo lonke ilizwe ngokunika imilinganiselo emifutshane nokukhohlisa kwiisikali.
Babesoyikisa nabahambi endleleni kwaye besasaza ukonakala emhlabeni wonke.
Ndabakhuthaza ukuba banqule uAllah kuphela kwaye bathembeke ngokupheleleyo xa beqhubana nabanye.
Bayigatya isigidimi sam baza basongela ngokundigxotha mna kunye nabo babekholwa nam kweli lizwe.
U-Allah wandisindisa mna nabalandeli bam ngenceba Yakhe, ngelixa abenzi bobubi babanjwa sisohlwayo esibi kakhulu.

outcome.label: Isiphelo Sabo
options: Amatye odongwe olutshisiweyo awela phezu kwabo

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
